premise: Fox doesn't believe Frog was once a tiny wiggly tadpole; Beaver shows him the tadpoles in the pond.
inspiration: Kipling's Just So stories (how the animal got its legs), told truly: the doubter is shown, not told, and the proof is right there in the pond.
lesson: Everyone starts small and changes as they grow.
learning: Frogs start life as tadpoles swimming in water

en-US.title: Frog Was a Tadpole
en-US.text: [excited] I used to be a tadpole, said Frog {frog:pulse}. [laughs] A what? said Fox {fox:wobble}. You're joking! A tiny wiggly thing with a tail, said Frog, swimming in the pond. No legs at all! Fox didn't believe a word. Frogs have legs, he said. Big springy ones. So Beaver {beaver:hop} took them to the edge of the pond. [whispers] Look closely, he said. {sfx:water solo} There in the water were lots of little black tadpoles, wiggle, wiggle, some with tiny back legs just starting to grow. [gasps] They'll be frogs one day, said Beaver. Fox {fox:sparkle} stared and stared. Then Frog {frog:live} sprang up, did a backflip onto her lily pad, and caught a fly. Snap! [giggles] See? she said. Those legs were worth the wait.

es-ES.title: Rana fue renacuajo
es-ES.text: [excited] Yo antes era un renacuajo, dijo Rana {frog:pulse}. [laughs] ¿Un qué?, dijo Zorro {fox:wobble}. ¡Estás de broma! Una cosita pequeña que se menea, con cola, dijo Rana, nadando en la charca. ¡Sin patas! Zorro no se creía ni una palabra. Las ranas tienen patas, dijo. Grandes y saltarinas. Así que Castor {beaver:hop} los llevó a la orilla de la charca. [whispers] Mirad bien, dijo. {sfx:water solo} Allí, en el agua, había un montón de renacuajos negritos, meneo, meneo, algunos con unas patitas traseras que empezaban a crecer. [gasps] Un día serán ranas, dijo Castor. Zorro {fox:sparkle} miraba y miraba. Entonces Rana {frog:live} dio un brinco, una voltereta hasta su hoja de nenúfar, y atrapó una mosca. ¡Zas! [giggles] ¿Lo ves?, dijo. Mereció la pena esperar a tener estas patas.
